## Paths

I'm going to set this up to dump data to the QAEL WERP share for now. Unfortunately, that calls itself something different for each of us.

```{r}
#| include: false
qaelpath <- myhome
#qaelpath <- path.expand(qaelpath)
datDir <- file.path(qaelpath, "Deakin University/QAEL - MER/Model/dataBase")
datOut <- file.path(qaelpath, "Deakin University/QAEL - SRA - SRA/data_out")
project_dir <- file.path(datOut, 'werpstyle')
hydro_dir <- file.path(project_dir, 'hydrographs')

# Generated data
# EWR outputs (will be created here in controller, read from here in aggregator)
ewr_results <- file.path(project_dir, 'module_output', 'EWR_numeric_gauges')
ewr_results <- file.path(project_dir, 'MANUAL')

# outputs of aggregator. There may be multiple modules
agg_results <- file.path(project_dir, 'aggregator_output_numeric_gauges')

comp_results <- file.path(project_dir, 'comparer_output') 

data_path <- file.path(qaelpath, "Deakin University/QAEL - SRA - SRA/data_out/SRA_analysis/Final_datasets_2025")
```

```{r}
Tagg_gauge_EWRversions <- read.csv(file.path(project_dir, 'MANUAL', 'EWR_summary.csv'))
Timeseries_gauge_EWRversions <- read.csv(file.path(project_dir, 'MANUAL', 'EWR_timeseries.csv'))

#filter EWRs == NA
Tagg_gauge_EWRversions <- filter(Tagg_gauge_EWRversions, !is.na(ewr_achieved))
Timeseries_gauge_EWRversions <- filter(Timeseries_gauge_EWRversions, !is.na(ewr_achieved))

#Clean ewr_code
Tagg_gauge_EWRversions$ewr_code <- sub("-", "_", Tagg_gauge_EWRversions$ewr_code)
Timeseries_gauge_EWRversions$ewr_code <- sub("-", "_", Timeseries_gauge_EWRversions$ewr_code)

#SWITCH CFs
Tagg_gauge_EWRversions <- Tagg_gauge_EWRversions |>
  mutate(ewr_achieved = case_when(ewr_code == "ALT" ~ 1-ewr_achieved,
                                  ewr_code == "CF" ~ 1-ewr_achieved,
                                  ewr_code == "CF1" ~ 1-ewr_achieved,
                                  ewr_code == "CF1_c_P" ~ 1-ewr_achieved,
                                  ewr_code == "CF1_c_S" ~ 1-ewr_achieved,
                                  .default = ewr_achieved))

Timeseries_gauge_EWRversions <- Timeseries_gauge_EWRversions |>
  mutate(ewr_achieved = case_when(ewr_code == "ALT" ~ 1-ewr_achieved,
                                  ewr_code == "CF" ~ 1-ewr_achieved,
                                  ewr_code == "CF1" ~ 1-ewr_achieved,
                                  ewr_code == "CF1_c_P" ~ 1-ewr_achieved,
                                  ewr_code == "CF1_c_S" ~ 1-ewr_achieved,
                                  .default = ewr_achieved))


Timeseries_gauge_EWRversions <- Timeseries_gauge_EWRversions |>
  select(year, ewr_code, scenario, gauge, planning_unit_name, ewr_code_timing, ewr_achieved)

```

## For joining EWR groups and connectivity groups

```{r}
EWRS_df <- Tagg_gauge_EWRversions |>
  distinct(ewr_code) |>
  mutate(ewr_group_temp1 = substr(ewr_code, start = 1, stop = 2)) |>
  mutate(ewr_group_temp2 = substr(ewr_code, start = 1, stop = 1)) |> #DODGY BUT WILL DO FOR NOW
  mutate(ewr_group = case_when(ewr_group_temp2 == "F" ~ ewr_group_temp2, 
                               ewr_group_temp1 == "W-" ~ "LF",
                               .default = ewr_group_temp1)) |>
  mutate(ewr_group = ifelse(is.na(ewr_group), ewr_group_temp1, ewr_group)) |>
  select(-ewr_group_temp1, -ewr_group_temp2)

List_EWRs <- read.csv(file.path(project_dir, "List_EWRs.csv"))

List_EWRs$ewr_code <- sub("-", "_", List_EWRs$ewr_code)
EWRS_df$ewr_code <- sub("-", "_", EWRS_df$ewr_code)


EWRS_df <- left_join(EWRS_df, List_EWRs, by = "ewr_code")


```

```{r}
#TIMESERIES - GROUPED EWRS BY LONG and LATERAL cONNECTIVITY

# VALLEY RESULTS!
Timeseries_valley_LATERALgroup <- Timeseries_gauge_EWR |>
  dplyr::mutate(ValleyName = ifelse(ValleyName == "Nebine", "Condamine Balonne", ValleyName),
                name_clean = ifelse(name_clean == "Nebine", "CondamineBalonne", name_clean))|>
  dplyr::filter(Lateral_connectivity_including_SF == "Y")|>
  dplyr::select(-gauge,
                -Lateral_connectivity_including_SF, -Lateral_connectivity_above_BK, -Lateral_connectivity_including_BK,
                -Longitudinal_connectivity_CF, -Longitudinal_connectivity_FD)|>
  dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(c(-ewr_achieved, - ewr_code, -ewr_group
                                  #, -ewr_code_timing
                                  )))|>
  dplyr::reframe(ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved, na.rm = TRUE),
                 n_EWRs = n())

#"year"         "scenario"    "ValleyName"   "name_clean"   "ewr_achieved" n_EWRs


Timeseries_valley_LONGITUDINALgroup <- Timeseries_gauge_EWR |>
  dplyr::mutate(ValleyName = ifelse(ValleyName == "Nebine", "Condamine Balonne", ValleyName),
                name_clean = ifelse(name_clean == "Nebine", "CondamineBalonne", name_clean))|>
  dplyr::filter(Longitudinal_connectivity_CF == "Y" | Longitudinal_connectivity_FD == "Y") |>
  dplyr::select(-gauge,
                -Longitudinal_connectivity_CF, -Longitudinal_connectivity_FD, -Lateral_connectivity_above_BK,
                -Lateral_connectivity_including_BK, -Lateral_connectivity_including_SF)|>
  dplyr::group_by(dplyr::across(c(-ewr_achieved, -ewr_code, -ewr_group
                                  #, -ewr_code_timing
                                  )))|>
  dplyr::reframe(ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved, na.rm = TRUE),
                 n_EWRs = n())

#"year"         "scenario"   "ValleyName"   "name_clean"   "ewr_achieved" n_EWRs

# basin level
Timeseries_Basin_LATERALgroup <- Timeseries_valley_LATERALgroup |> 
  ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(-ValleyName, -name_clean)|>
  dplyr::group_by(year)|>
  dplyr::reframe(ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved, na.rm = TRUE),
                 n_EWRs = sum(n_EWRs))

# basin level
Timeseries_Basin_LONGITUDINALgroup <- Timeseries_valley_LONGITUDINALgroup |> 
  ungroup() |>
  dplyr::select(-ValleyName, -name_clean)|>
  dplyr::group_by(year)|>
  dplyr::reframe(ewr_achieved = mean(ewr_achieved, na.rm = TRUE),
                 n_EWRS = sum(n_EWRs))
```

```{r}
gauges_df
```

#how many EWRs in each valley

```{r}
Longitudinal_EWRS <- Timeseries_gauge_EWR |>
    filter(Longitudinal_connectivity_CF == "Y" | Longitudinal_connectivity_FD == "Y") |>
    distinct(ValleyName, ewr_code, gauge,  Longitudinal_connectivity_CF, Longitudinal_connectivity_FD)|>
    group_by(ValleyName)|>
    summarise(`Number of EWRs relating to Longitudinal connectivity` = n(),
              `Number of gauges` = length(unique(gauge)))


Lateral_EWRS <- Timeseries_gauge_EWR |>
    filter(Lateral_connectivity_including_SF == "Y") |>
    distinct(ValleyName, ewr_code, gauge,  Lateral_connectivity_including_SF)|>
    group_by(ValleyName)|>
    summarise(`Number of EWRs relating to Lateral connectivity` = n(),
              `Number of gauges` = length(unique(gauge)))
```

```{r}
Lat <- EWRS_df |>
  filter(Lateral_connectivity_including_SF == "Y") |>
  distinct(ewr_code)


#Long
Long <- EWRS_df |>
  filter(Longitudinal_connectivity_CF == "Y" | Longitudinal_connectivity_FD == "Y") |>
  distinct(ewr_code)


write.csv(
  Long,
  file.path(qaelpath, "Deakin University/QAEL - SRA - SRA/data_out/SRA_analysis/UpdatedReport_plots",
            paste0("List_Longitudinal_connectivity_EWRS", "_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))

write.csv(
  Lat,
  file.path(qaelpath, "Deakin University/QAEL - SRA - SRA/data_out/SRA_analysis/UpdatedReport_plots", 
            paste0("List_Lateral_connectivity_EWRS", "_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")))
```
